---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in public, offline code or documentation
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: []
---

## What happened?

Describe the behavior without submitting secrets, private account data, screenshots containing personal details, or internal files.

## How to reproduce

Use only synthetic or independently publishable examples. Include the smallest possible inputs, commands, and observed output.

## What did you expect?

State the expected outcome and the public specification or existing test that supports it.

## Environment

Python version and operating system if relevant.

## Publication check

- [ ] All inputs and attachments are public or synthetic.
- [ ] This issue contains no credentials, proprietary methods, or identifiable private data.
- [ ] The reported issue does not depend on live trading or wallet access.
